manifest.title: Many Worlds Historian
manifest.tagline: Explore network history collected by Malcolm
manifest.description:
Many Worlds Historian is a web application for exploring network history collected by Malcolm.

* See activity over time, alerts, protocols and the busiest hosts for any time range.
* Click a host, protocol or rule to filter the whole page, and open any event to see its raw record.
* Access uses your Cloudron login.

This test version shows **simulated data only**. Everything on screen is invented, and the page says so in a banner.
manifest.changelog: * First test version, showing simulated Malcolm data.
manifest.postInstallMessage:
Sign in with your Cloudron account. Only users you grant access to this app can open it.

This version shows **simulated data**. It does not connect to a Malcolm instance yet.

manifest.title: Many Worlds Historian
manifest.tagline: Explore network history collected by Malcolm
manifest.description:
Many Worlds Historian is a web application for exploring network history collected by Malcolm.

* See activity over time, alerts, protocols and the busiest hosts for any time range.
* Click a host, protocol or rule to filter the whole page, and open any event to see its raw record.
* Open a printable report: whether the monitoring was complete, findings ranked by severity, who sent commands to controllers, what changed since the period before, and hosts checked against the asset inventory.
* Access uses your Cloudron login.

This test version shows **simulated data only**. Everything on screen is invented, and the page says so in a banner.
manifest.changelog:
* The report now starts by saying whether its numbers can be trusted: sensor status, gaps in the record, capture loss and whether Malcolm's searches were complete.
* New report section on controller changes: who sent write or operate commands to controllers, and whether the sender's role is one that should.
* New report section on what changed since the period before: new devices, connections, protocols and external destinations, and devices no longer seen.
* The dashboard warns when Malcolm could only search part of its data.
* The simulated plant now keeps two weeks of history, so a weekly report has an earlier week to compare with.
manifest.postInstallMessage:
Sign in with your Cloudron account. Only users you grant access to this app can open it.

This version shows **simulated data**. It does not connect to a Malcolm instance yet.
